meta.name: test-driven-development
meta.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code

copy.tagline: 先写测试再写代码，确保功能正确
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果习惯用测试驱动开发来保证代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Write tests before code to ensure correctness
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you practice test-driven development to ensure code quality

howto.what: Claude 会先让你写测试，再写实现代码。它要求测试必须失败一次，然后写最少代码让测试通过，最后清理代码。
howto.when: 当你要求实现新功能、修复 bug、重构或改变行为时，在写任何实现代码之前触发。

say.text: 帮我用 TDD 实现一个用户注册功能。
say.note: Claude 会先让你写测试，再写实现。

say.text: 修复这个 bug：空邮箱被接受。
say.note: Claude 会要求先写一个复现 bug 的测试。

howto.what_en: Claude will ask you to write a failing test first, then minimal code to pass it, then refactor. It enforces the Red-Green-Refactor cycle strictly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request a new feature, bug fix, refactoring, or behavior change, before any implementation code is written.

say_en.text: Help me implement a user registration feature using TDD.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through writing a test first.

say_en.text: Fix this bug: empty email is accepted.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for a failing test first.
